note: One file, one revision, two consumers. Recorded BESIDE a tree hash, never inside the preimage: baking the revision into the preimage would invalidate every historical hash on a list edit and make hashes incomparable across the change, which is worse than the divergence it fixes.

semantics.directories: excluded when ANY path segment matches, so a nested node_modules is caught
semantics.files: excluded when the BASENAME matches, at any depth

caveat: Generated output is excluded; this list is that rule's current instance. A project whose released artefact IS dist would hash nothing under it, so the reason column is what keeps the next edit honest.
